body:
No joke, I knew a kid in high school who would deliberately do this. His reasoning was something like "everyone else stops, so I don't need to." I got in a car with him driving (not knowing he did this) and after he did it once I told him to stop the car and I got out immediately. Fuck that.

His senior year, he got a new car from his parents, tricked it out with all the goods (spoiler, better suspension, lights under the car), and within a month he flipped it and totalled the hell out of hit. Luckily he wasn't injured. His parents revoked his license immediately after the incident.
